observation: Captured in open-1 (siteId three_hull_garden, strainId charon_grave, driveState anchored, draws 10, size 72.80 x 41.22 x 71.69 WU). Close and chase frames show a large squashed tissue-mapped sphere mound (ab_mound) with subtle radial polar UV convergence near top center, topped by a bright faceted 12x8 glowing orange sphere crown (ab_crown, emissiveIntensity 1.2) and small 6-sided cone spikes (ab_spike) largely buried into the mound slope so only 3-4 tips protrude near the crown. Fixed 144 WU chase framing slightly clips top/bottom rim of the mound; close fits completely. Silhouette reads as a bumped primitive dome with an unshaded glowing orange ball rather than a mineral-processing mantle with anchor tendrils. Active defend posture, alternate strains, and ordinary-play encounters were not captured.
decision: disposition: needs follow-up — featureless primitive sphere mound and faceted glowing sphere crown, largely buried cone spikes, polar UV convergence, and tight chase framing.
next: Rebuild as a folded organic mantle with sculpted mineral/tendril anchor silhouette, replace the faceted emissive ball with recessed restrained glow organs, verify chase framing, and recapture.
